title: FAQ Dictionary & Types — i18n keys for public FAQ page
content:
Add the `faqPage` dictionary keys and `FaqPageDict` type for the public FAQ page, plus `breadcrumbs.faq` key.

New keys in all 3 dictionary JSON files (en, zh-hk, zh-cn):
```
faqPage: {
  pageTitle: "Frequently Asked Questions",
  pageDescription: "Find answers to common questions...",
  searchPlaceholder: "Search questions...",
  noResults: "No questions match your search.",
  emptyState: "No FAQs available at this time.",
  loadingMessage: "Loading FAQs..."
}

breadcrumbs: {
  ...existing,
  faq: "FAQ"
}
```

Types update: add `FaqPageDict = Dictionary["faqPage"]` to types.ts

No UI code. Only dictionary JSON files + types.ts.
acceptance: en.json has `faqPage` object with all required keys
zh-hk.json has `faqPage` with translated Chinese values
zh-cn.json has `faqPage` with simplified Chinese values
npm run typecheck && npm run lint pass
verification: npm run typecheck && npm run lint
